name: Inukawa Sousuke
source:
Warrior who holds the orb of 'justice'.
The protagonist's childhood friend who is quite protective of her.
He's a servant at the mansion of his village's mayor.
On [url=/c42257]Hamaji's[/url] order he is accompanying the protagonist on her journey.
